requires.degrade: Without node, the WebFetch truncation hook cannot launch, so a truncated WebFetch result gets no note pointing at /discovery:read-docs, and the docs-fetcher gate cannot launch, so a discovery:docs-fetcher subagent's Bash is held only by the session's own permission rules.
Without curl, /discovery:read-docs cannot fetch a docs page and records it unread with reason curl-missing; a cached entry still within --max-age is served without a request.
Without jq, fetch-docs.sh and docs-cache.sh exit before reading anything, so /discovery:read-docs stops.
Without Python 3, a page that serves only HTML cannot be converted and is recorded unread with reason no-python; pages served as markdown read normally.
